title: Sneaker Captions Stay Safely Inside
tests: Tests caption accuracy, legibility and explicit safe-area placement throughout a finished vertical product ad.

faults.what: All three captions appear together in one stacked block at 1.9 seconds instead of appearing sequentially across the three shots; no captions appear in the later supplied frames.

judge.summary: The silent vertical sneaker ad shows the requested white product, but incorrectly presents all three captions together near the beginning rather than in sequence.

must_haves.item: One silent 9:16 video runs for approximately 15 seconds and contains three moving product shots.
must_haves.why: The supplied metadata confirms a silent 15-second video, and the frames are 9:16 with different product views, but still frames cannot establish three moving shots.

must_haves.item: The sneaker is consistently a white leather low-top with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
must_haves.why: The visible sneaker consistently has a white leather-like upper, low-top silhouette, white laces and white sole, with no visible logo.

must_haves.item: The captions read exactly “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.” and “Shop now”, in that order.
must_haves.why: The wording is exact, but all three captions are displayed simultaneously rather than in the requested temporal order.

must_haves.item: Every visible caption's full bounds stay within the central 70% of frame width and central 60% of frame height, including during transitions.
must_haves.why: The visible lettering at 1.9 seconds fits within the specified safe area, but caption transitions are not shown and cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: Captions are legible against the footage and remain visible long enough to read.
must_haves.why: The white lettering on a dark translucent panel is clearly legible, but the supplied frames do not establish how long the caption block remains visible.
